functions.desc: Generate a DOE design matrix (full/taguchi/fractional/rsm/bb); StdOrder + RunOrder + coded factors.

args.name: method
args.desc: Design method: FULL, TAGUCHI, FRACTIONAL, RSM, or BB

args.name: [seed]
args.desc: Fixed seed for reproducible run order

functions.expr: DoeCore.Plan( InputNormalizer.ToInt32(qty1), InputNormalizer.ToInt32(level1), InputNormalizer.ToInt32(qty2), InputNormalizer.ToInt32(level2), InputNormalizer.ToString(method), InputNormalizer.ToBool(randomize, true), InputNormalizer.IsOmitted(seed) ? (long?)null : InputNormalizer.ToLong(seed))
